notes: Mt Adams foot, sheet drawn rotated (north arrow points ~50 deg right of page-up). BAUM (37' printed near the top, 39' at mid-sheet, 33' twice at the south end; 33 recorded) and OREGON (40') run NNW-SSE and steepen to page-south before T-ing into E. 3RD (50', north face y~4300, south face y~4475). Both continue NNW past the Mt. Adams & Eden Park Inclined Plane off the top-left edge; no intersections up there. A strip of WOOD STEPS runs from Oregon's east side ENE (about (1300,860) to (1700,700)); not a street. CELESTIAL (50') enters from the NE at the top (the leg toward Sidereal/Monastery), turns SSE, then SE, then page-south; a short ENE stub on its east face at about (3080,1700) is the foot of the steps up to Sidereal Street (sheet 128), not a street. Celestial narrows to 40' south of Hill and runs to 3rd; sheet 109 prints CELESTIAL on that south leg, so it is named Celestial here too (its house numbers are 301-315, while Celestial north of Hill is numbered 1001-1075 from Hill). HILL is offset at Celestial: west part (40', centre y~3588) runs from River View Place to Celestial, east part (50', centre y~3508) runs from Celestial off the right edge to sheet 109; recorded as two T's with the west part suffixed '(west of Celestial)'. RIVER VIEW PL. (35') runs from a dead end at y~3245 south to Hill; south of Hill it continues as an unnamed 15' alley (x~3151-3205) down to 3rd, recorded as an alley. FILSON PL. (30' printed at both ends) runs from a dead end at x~2841 east to Celestial. The incline line near 3rd and the inclined plane at the top are ignored as railroad. Scale ~3.44 px/ft.
